text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, I was trying something out to
bring out more of Rulership's potential.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Uhh... 2-3 Rook Promotes!
...Gold takes, 3-2 Gold! Next!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Machine-gun tsumeshogi.
It really is perfect as a mental warm-up.
choice_data_list: We have three mock races today, think you can handle it?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh, who do you think you're talking to?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I saw it coming! That a path would open up here for a split second!
However, that space... is the Rook's domain!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
And... here the Rook promotes to a Dragon...! 
No one can stop it now...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Everything... is in the palm of my hand...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Naturally.
That's what all the preparations were for, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Adapting to the constantly shifting tides of battle, instantly choosing the correct move from among countless prepared strategies—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Machine-gun tsumeshogi... Not a bad idea.
Keep interesting suggestions like that coming.
